note: Drives agent docs/index.html via scripts/build-doc-index.js. Groups are matched top-down by the first `match` prefix/regex that hits; anything unmatched lands in Unsorted, so new pages always appear. `desc` overrides are optional — without one, the page's own <title> is used.

descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/agent-measurem: The front door to all the measurement tooling: the three report pages, every command, and a ranked queue of five experiments to run. Includes the settled facts so you don't re-derive them.
descriptions.probe-baseline-log.html: 20 fixed questions, each answered in a fresh read-only session, so the tasks never vary and any difference between runs is caused by what you changed. Baseline: 20/20 correct, 867k tokens. Includes the navigation-cost list.
descriptions.token-usage-log.html: Real billed tokens from your Claude Code history plus Cursor's local counts. Reading files costs ~4× editing them; a turn in a 600+ turn session costs ~8× a turn in a short one.
descriptions.session-tracking-log.html: One row per completed task — expand to see the doc navigation path. Now records real token cost per task.
descriptions.session-metrics-log.html: Greps, files, and hook tallies — one card per finalized session.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/measuring-agen: Plain-language audit of 342 task bumps: three of the four old tracking gauges were measuring their own instrumentation. Read this if the measurement pages stop making sense.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/doc-restructur: What the agent reads and in what order to find anything. The two-kinds-of-guidance split, worked examples with read counts.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/head-agents-md: Visual summary of the Programs-root always-on file: what each section does and what belongs elsewhere.
descriptions.context-engineering-infographic.html: Why the instruction layer is shaped the way it is.
descriptions.context-engineering-capture-ladder.html: The five rungs, and why a rule should be pushed as high as it goes.
descriptions.context-engineering-capture-costs.html: What each rung of the capture ladder costs per session.
descriptions.rule-architecture-infographic.html: How the guidance system works. Predates the index restructure, so parts may now be wrong.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/student-portal: Walkthrough of the grading pipeline: Math App Studio designs an app, the portal runs it, Supabase stores anonymous results, Macro App puts the names back. Includes seven weak spots ranked worst-first.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/course-setup-m: Setup steps create information nodes; Macro App tabs pull from those nodes — course list, schedule, calendar link, roster, assignment calendar.
descriptions.scratch/macro-app-launch-paths.html: Why the .bat launch feels worse than the dashboard one, and how to fix it.
descriptions.scratch/gradebook-pull-timing-map.html: Timing map for the gradebook pull.
descriptions.scratch/supabase-setup.html: Supabase setup for student progress storage.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/agent-docs-rev: The 12 top-level instruction-layer markdowns in agent docs/ — dates, purpose, and a keep / update / remove call on each.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/macro-app-docs: All 50 markdowns under Macro App checked against live code. 38 accurate as-is; drift concentrated in the ADR set.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/electron-toolb: All 39 markdowns under electron-toolbar/ checked against live code. 11 of 16 flagged files deleted.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/app-dashboard-: First app in the conformance-pass series. All 12 App Dashboard markdowns checked; 5 deleted, 2 fixed.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/recipes-review: The 26 interaction recipes checked against live code and split by owning app — only 3 were genuinely cross-app.
descriptions.instructional-layer-htmls/cursor-pattern: Historical record of the review that eliminated cursor-patterns/ — 6 files merged into recipes/, 11 deleted.
descriptions.scratch/dice-sums.html: Two dice, part 1 — every ordered roll behind each sum from 2 to 12, ending on 36.
descriptions.scratch/dice-stats.html: Two dice, part 2 — the chart tips into a histogram, a normal curve lays over it, then mu = 7 and sigma = 2.42.
descriptions.scratch/dice-sampling.html: Two dice, part 3 — 100 sample means of four rolls rain onto the same axis, and sigma / root n predicts the spread.
descriptions.scratch/dice-products.html: Two dice, part 4 — the product is spiky and gap-riddled, yet its sampling distribution still goes normal. The Central Limit Theorem.
descriptions.scratch/dice-series.html: Two dice, all four parts stitched into one 4:27 video — sums, histogram and mu/sigma, sampling distribution, then products and the Central Limit Theorem.
